rules.statement: The court has an inherent power to refuse a claim in reconvention if it is such as likely to cause embarrassment or prejudice and delay the trial of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is argued that inasmuch as the Civil Procedure Code does not expressly confer such power the Court must entertain a claim in reconversion of whatever kind or nature. But, in my opinion, such express provision is not required; the Court has, I think, an inherent power in a matter like this."
